minutes.headline: Planning Board elected a new chair and worked through the zoning use table for commercial and industrial uses
minutes.summary: The board reorganized after a member left to join the Board of Selectmen, choosing a chair, vice chair, clerk and committee representatives. Most of the meeting went on the zoning use table: auto repair, boat repair, construction sales, recreation uses and a proposed separate firing range definition, agriculture, earth removal, kennels and veterinary uses. The board also heard committee reports and discussed the building inspector search and filling the vacant seat.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board reorganized after a member left for the Board of Selectmen, voting a new chair, vice chair and clerk.
Most of the meeting went to the zoning use table, and the board referred the revisions to staff for a redraft.
The board agreed to merge retail commercial into commercial and to make equipment sales and similar uses special permit uses.
Planning staff will draft a separate firing range definition as a special permit use under recreation, for the board to consider next meeting.
The chair will notify the Board of Selectmen of the vacancy so the joint interview process can start.

why_it_matters: The use table sets which businesses may locate where in town and which need a special permit, so the redraft could change what can be built near residents.
The vacant seat is to be filled through a joint process with the Board of Selectmen, which decides who votes on future zoning and permit decisions.
watch_next: The board's next meeting, where it is to consider the staff draft of a separate firing range definition.
The joint interview process with the Board of Selectmen to fill the vacant Planning Board seat.

reconciliation.summary: The records agree that G. Bittner was elected chair and that the vacancy would be reported to the Selectmen. They differ on the other officers' names, the budget transfer and figures, and the zoning decisions. Our minutes name Matt Bells and Ken Janice, where the official minutes give Allison and Chenis, and they record a school building transfer that the official minutes do not.
